The '''''Gilded Thranta''''' was an [[FX-77 Star Yacht]] owned by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Falloon]], the former [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] account Soolehad, during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. It was armed with two turreted, top and bottom mounted dual [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and a [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]] with twelve [[Concussion missile/Legends|missiles]]. After a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] helped him and his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[9T-LOM]] evacuate from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] during the [[Invasion of Sriluur]], Falloon brought 9T-LOM to associates on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="LCaL" /> and gave the ship to the group of mercenaries and retired.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
